episodes.synopsis: When Chitose Sakuraba, an eleven year old girl, declares her "hots" for Hiroshi Kashiwabara she plans to skip class to go see him, but her tutor Asako Fuji stands in her way.
episodes.title: The Encounter Between Me and Onii-chan!!

episodes.synopsis: Chitose finds out that Hiroshi and Kouhai are having a marriage meeting, so must stop him at all costs as that sorta thing is for desperate people (in her mind).
episodes.title: The Marriage Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Chitose tries to figure out the best way to attract someone.
episodes.title: An Adult's Charm?

episodes.synopsis: Misaki tries to figure out what to do for Father's Day.
episodes.title: Daddy's Child

episodes.synopsis: Hinako tries on various bits of cosplay.
episodes.title: Hinako in Cosplay

episodes.synopsis: Asako makes some curious observations during her class' drawing lesson.
episodes.title: Sketch

episodes.synopsis: The school practises a fire drill.
episodes.title: Fire Drill

episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi's attempt to get Chitose to play with her friends instead of bothering him backfires when she brings her entire class to his office.
episodes.title: All Together!

episodes.synopsis: Chitose is constantly foiled in her plans to escape to the town hall to see Hiroshi.
episodes.title: The Usual Days

episodes.synopsis: Chitose struggles to come up with a wish for Tanabata.
episodes.title: The Teacher's Achilles' Heel?

episodes.synopsis: The girls try to learn Asako's weakness.
episodes.title: Tanabata

episodes.synopsis: Hinako picks a curious outfit for the swimming pool.
episodes.title: The Pool Opens

episodes.synopsis: At a summer festival in town, both Chitose and Asako end up fighting when Hiroshi appears.
episodes.title: Summer Festival

episodes.synopsis: Misaki has trouble picking out a library book for Book Week.
episodes.title: Reading Books in Autumn?

episodes.synopsis: It's sports festival day at the school.
episodes.title: Sports Festival

episodes.synopsis: Chitose gets a new rival with the appearance of Hiroshi's Neice, Mika.
episodes.title: Mika Appears

episodes.synopsis: Chitose and Asako go to a restaurant with Hiroshi and get on each other's nerves.
episodes.title: The Meal

episodes.synopsis: Asako goes on a diet, which gives Chitose the idea to go on one herself.
episodes.title: Diet?

episodes.synopsis: After an awkward incident on the way to school, Chitose and Hinako try to help Misaki to behave more like a girl.
episodes.title: Like a Girl

episodes.synopsis: Chitose and Asako think of christmas presents to give to Hiroshi.
episodes.title: Christmas

episodes.title: Spring Cleaning and Memories

episodes.synopsis: Chitose and co. go about giving New Year's greetings whilst Asako and Kouhai spend the day drinking.
episodes.title: New Year's Eve

episodes.synopsis: The gang visit the temple for the New Year.
episodes.title: Visiting the Temple for the New Year

episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi describes a typical day in his life.
episodes.title: A Day in the Life of Kashiwabara

episodes.synopsis: Asako teaches the girls how to make handmade Valentine chocolates.
episodes.title: Let's Do It Handmade

episodes.synopsis: Chitose and Mika argue over who gets to give Hiroshi their chocolate first and end up incurring Misaki's wrath.
episodes.title: First One Wins
